purpose: Read-only closure review of the eleven pending litchi-rtf matrix rows against the finalized native Microsoft Word RTF corpus. This file records bounded evidence and the smallest useful native follow-ups; it does not change fixture_status.

provenance.authoring_method: Computer Use / native Microsoft Word UI for the existing fixtures
provenance.analysis_method: Read-only coverage-row, source-matrix, raw-RTF, inspection-metadata, hash, and existing reader-result comparison
provenance.native_reopen_claim: The cited native Word fixtures were closed and reopened without a repair prompt where their inspection files record native_reopen=pass.

classification_rule.fixture_bounded: A native Word RTF contains raw controls directly related to the row, but the fixture covers only a bounded sub-scope or the litchi-rtf reader stops before typed traversal. This category never means that the broad matrix row is complete.
classification_rule.operation_only: The remaining assertion is transport, CRUD, refresh, execution, or another operation that a native saved RTF cannot certify as a file-only fixture.
classification_rule.producer_unavailable: The exact RTF construct is absent from this native Word 16.110.2/macOS corpus and no deterministic current native Word authoring route was observed. This is a producer/workflow boundary, not a claim that no historical or other producer can emit it.
classification_rule.concrete_missing_authorable_recipe: No finalized fixture exists, but a small native Word UI operation can be tried and accepted only after the expected RTF controls are observed after close and reopen. No RTF bytes are synthesized by this audit.

summary.native_rtf_reader_policy: No native Word RTF fixture is promoted to a semantic litchi-rtf pass. Every known native RTF file in this corpus contains one empty starred datastore group, but four files stop earlier at a different parser boundary; the datastore is therefore a common raw construct and not a universal first-error claim.
summary.reader_error_scope_note: The nine empty-datastore results are word-bidi-eastasia, word-document-protection, word-embedded-fonts, word-layout-extensions, word-legacy-form, word-review-controls, word-rtf-minimal, word-rtf-table-grid, and word-visual-objects. word-tables-layout stops at duplicate typed style ID; word-mailmerge-fields stops at invalid file-table entry count; word-math-navigation stops at an unsupported math object destination; word-vector-diagram stops at an unstarred shape-group shprslt destination.

common_raw_absence_scan.interpretation: These are measured absences in the current native corpus. They do not establish that Word or another producer can never emit the controls.

bounded_evidence: word-bidi-eastasia.rtf has ANSI/CP1252 header controls, Unicode \u fallbacks, \uc values 1 and 2, language groups for Arabic, Hebrew, Japanese, and Chinese, and selected legacy font charsets.
The same fixture records 146 font definitions/\fcharset controls, 220 hex fallbacks, and body language groups on source lines 103-127 in its inspection metadata.
rows.reader_observation: The native reader invocation exits 1 at the empty datastore group; no typed Unicode/code-page traversal is claimed.
rows.native_ui_follow_up: No new broad fixture is required for the current bounded evidence. If an isolated code-page specimen is useful, create one plain paragraph, select one Japanese/Chinese font, add one non-ASCII character and one explicit Unicode character, save as RTF, close, reopen, and require the expected \fcharset/\u/\uc controls before recording it.

rows.feature: Unknown control words and starred destinations
bounded_evidence: All thirteen native Word RTF files contain a starred empty \datastore destination and a starred \themedata destination; their headers also contain the XML namespace table destination.
These are producer-emitted starred destinations, but the corpus does not isolate an intentionally unknown control word. The exact unknown-control sub-scope therefore remains unproven.

machine_checkable_expectations.expected_error: MalformedDocument("RTF data-store payload cannot be empty")

rows.reader_observation: The empty datastore is the first failure in the minimal, review, bidi, layout, font, protection, form, and visual-object derivatives; earlier boundaries occur in the other four rich files listed in native_rtf_corpus.
rows.native_ui_follow_up: Save a blank Word document as RTF and compare its starred destinations with the minimal fixture. Word UI cannot request an arbitrary unknown control word; an exact unknown-control isolation would require a legacy or other producer, so no synthetic RTF is proposed.

bounded_evidence: Every native Word RTF in this corpus is ordinary RTF beginning with the plain RTF header; no file is an LZFu or MELA transport frame.
The library's transport contract is already exercised by exact LZFu vectors and compress/decompress round trips in transport_and_producer_contracts.rs lines 13-64.

machine_checkable_expectations.expected: LZFu detection, decompress, exact recompress, no-op write, and changed-write refusal

rows.reader_observation: This row does not require a native Word RTF semantic parse; the native corpus cannot certify compressed transport behavior.
rows.native_ui_follow_up: None for Word. A compressed fixture belongs to an Outlook/MS-OXRTFCP transport producer or the existing codec vector suite; Save As RTF in Word is not a useful authoring route for this frame.

bounded_evidence: Native RTF body and header controls cover Unicode, fonts, colors, paragraph alignment, spacing, indentation, breaks, fields, notes, tables, revisions, and shape/text stories across the layout, review, bidi, and visual-object derivatives.
The raw controls are useful file evidence but the reader does not reach typed traversal for these native files.
rows.reader_observation: word-tables-layout stops at duplicate typed style ID; review and bidi stop at empty datastore. These failures prevent a broad typed-format pass claim.
rows.native_ui_follow_up: For a single-control isolation, author one short paragraph with bold, italic, underline, strike, color, a tab, first-line indent, spacing, and a page break; save as RTF, close, reopen, and record only controls actually present. The existing corpus already supplies higher-value combined raw coverage.

bounded_evidence: Every native Word RTF derivative contains a \latentstyles destination and the surrounding \lsd* style visibility/priority/lock controls. The bidi inspection records the stylesheet/default source region as lines 53-92 and the raw RTF has one latentstyles control.
The current files do not isolate a before/after style restriction change, and the typed reader stops before semantic projection.
rows.reader_observation: Raw stylesheet evidence is available; no native RTF semantic count is available because the known reader errors occur before traversal.
rows.native_ui_follow_up: On a blank Word document, open the Styles pane's Manage Styles/Recommend or Hide controls if exposed, change one built-in style visibility/priority, save as RTF, close, reopen, and compare the lsd* controls. If the UI does not expose a saved restriction change, keep this row fixture-bounded.

bounded_evidence: Every native Word RTF has an \info destination with author, creation/revision time, version and document-count metadata, plus \themedata, \xmlnstbl and \datastore destinations.
The datastore is present as an empty payload in every file; no populated native custom-XML store is available in this corpus.

machine_checkable_expectations.expected: empty datastore payload_bytes=0 and reader rejection

rows.reader_observation: Document metadata is raw evidence only for the native corpus; the empty datastore prevents the semantic reader from exposing the typed info/data-store model in the affected files.
rows.native_ui_follow_up: Create a blank document, set one visible File > Properties value and one custom document property/variable if the installed Word UI exposes it, save as RTF, close, reopen, and require a nonempty corresponding destination. Do not call the attempt successful unless the raw RTF controls are present.

rows.feature: Bidirectional, associated-font, and East Asian formatting
bounded_evidence: word-bidi-eastasia.rtf directly records Arabic/Hebrew/Japanese/Chinese body language groups, \u/\uc fallbacks, \fcharset, \fcs0/\fcs1, \rtlch/\ltrch, associated fonts, and East Asian charset/font selections.

The same native audit records rtlpar_count=0, rtlsect_count=0, and kinsoku_count=0. The DOCX source likewise has no w:bidi, w:rtl, or w:kinsoku elements; explicit paragraph direction and custom Kinsoku remain outside this fixture.
rows.reader_observation: The native RTF reader stops at the empty datastore group on source line 273; no typed direction/associated-font/Kinsoku pass is claimed.
rows.native_ui_follow_up: If Word exposes Home > Paragraph right-to-left and an East Asian line-breaking/Kinsoku setting, author one Arabic/Hebrew paragraph and one punctuation-heavy CJK paragraph, save as RTF, close, reopen, and require \rtlpar or \rtlsect and \kinsoku. The current Computer Use probe did not expose those controls, so absence must remain a producer/workflow observation rather than invented syntax.

bounded_evidence: No current native Word RTF contains \writereservation or \writereservhash. The existing document-protection fixture is a different protection family and must not be treated as write-reservation evidence.
The matrix specifies the exact destinations and the writer emits them as starred root-header groups; the parser/writer tests use opaque, passive values only.

machine_checkable_expectations.expected: passive parse and retained write-back of both destinations

rows.reader_observation: No native file reaches this row's typed model because the required controls are absent; existing unit vectors are not native Office fixtures.
rows.native_ui_follow_up: Create a plain document, use Word Save As RTF and its Options/Security path to set a password to modify or write reservation if the installed UI exposes that setting, save, close, reopen, and scan for one or both starred \writereservhash/\writereservation destinations. Record the exact native result; do not infer that a password-to-modify dialog emits these specific RTF controls.

bounded_evidence: word-tables-layout.rtf contains two footer paragraph groups with \pvpara, \phmrg, \posxr, \posy0 and \overlay controls.

word-visual-objects.rtf contains a positioned picture paragraph with \phmrg, \posxr, \posyc, \dxfrtext180, \dfrmtxtx180 and \dfrmtxty0. These are raw positioned-layout evidence, while drawing text boxes and floating pictures remain separate matrix scopes.

machine_checkable_expectations.expected: raw positioned object and picture evidence; reader stops before semantic projection

rows.reader_observation: The table fixture stops at duplicate typed style ID and the visual-object fixture stops at empty datastore; no typed ParagraphFrame traversal is claimed.
rows.native_ui_follow_up: If Word exposes the legacy paragraph Frame command, create one paragraph-only frame with no picture or drawing shape, save as RTF, close, reopen, and require \pvpara/\ph* or equivalent frame controls without \shp* payloads. If the UI only exposes text boxes or floating pictures, retain the current fixture-bounded classification.

bounded_evidence: The current corpus has \xmlnstbl and \xmlns namespace-table controls, but no \xmlopen, \xmlclose, \xmlattr, \xmlattrns, or \factoidname groups.
Modern Word for Mac provided no deterministic SmartTag/factoid authoring route during this corpus work. The library's native vocabulary is documented separately from the current producer files.

machine_checkable_expectations.expected: starred xmlopen/xmlclose, xmlnsN, factoidname, xmlattr, xmlattrnsN vocabulary

rows.reader_observation: There is no native fixture containing this vocabulary, so no reader result is attached to this row.
rows.native_ui_follow_up: Use a Word version or legacy Smart Tags capable producer that exposes a saved SmartTag/factoid, then save as RTF and require paired starred \xmlopen/\xmlclose, \xmlnsN, \factoidname and an optional \xmlattr group. Do not synthesize these destinations in a Word fixture.

bounded_evidence: All thirteen native RTF headers carry \trackmoves0, but none contains the paired move-range destinations \mvfmf/\mvfml and \mvtof/\mvtol.
The existing review-controls fixture records ordinary \revised and \deleted controls only; ordinary tracked insertion/deletion is not move-bookmark evidence.

machine_checkable_expectations.expected: four move start/end controls and inert pairing semantics
paired source/destination move markers with six-byte payloads

rows.reader_observation: No native move-marker fixture exists; the existing unit test is a synthetic RTF vector and is not promoted to Office evidence.
rows.native_ui_follow_up: Enable Review > Track Changes > Track Moves if the installed Word UI exposes it, move one marked token from one paragraph to another, save as RTF, close, reopen, and require matched \mvfmf/\mvfml and \mvtof/\mvtol tags with the expected author/DTTM payload. If Track Moves is unavailable on this Word build, reclassify this candidate as producer_unavailable rather than fabricating controls.

high_value_rtf_coverage_gaps.evidence: All thirteen native RTF files have exactly one empty {\*\datastore } group; no file has payload bytes after the destination control.
high_value_rtf_coverage_gaps.minimal_follow_up: Use Word Developer/XML Mapping or another visible custom-XML route only if the installed UI exposes one; save and require nonempty datastore hex after native reopen.

high_value_rtf_coverage_gaps.gap: Native Grid Table 2 Accent 1 conditional table-style serialization
high_value_rtf_coverage_gaps.evidence: word-tables-layout.rtf has seven \ts36 groups for one logical style and stops at duplicate typed style ID; word-rtf-table-grid.rtf has one \ts35 group and reaches the empty datastore error instead.
high_value_rtf_coverage_gaps.minimal_follow_up: The existing pair is already the smallest useful native comparison; any new fixture should only be made if a separate conditional-style variant is needed.

high_value_rtf_coverage_gaps.evidence: word-embedded-fonts.rtf has ten \fontemb groups but the recorded empty fontemb group has zero payload bytes; its typed reader stops at datastore.
high_value_rtf_coverage_gaps.minimal_follow_up: A native font-embedding setting can be probed, but acceptance requires a nonempty RTF \fontemb payload and must not infer it from DOCX embedded fonts.

high_value_rtf_coverage_gaps.evidence: The matrix explicitly lists \jsksu, \jsku, \horzvert, \gcw, \twoinone, \nosectexpand, \sectexpand and \jclisttab as untyped; none occurs in the native corpus.
high_value_rtf_coverage_gaps.minimal_follow_up: No current native Word UI route was identified; preserve the explicit matrix exclusion rather than adding synthetic RTF.

high_value_rtf_coverage_gaps.gap: Rich native object and equation RTF semantic traversal
high_value_rtf_coverage_gaps.evidence: Native math, vector, visual-object, mail-merge and table RTF files preserve raw controls and reopen in Word, but each stops at a distinct litchi-rtf parser boundary before semantic counts.
high_value_rtf_coverage_gaps.minimal_follow_up: Keep raw controls, hashes, and exact first errors as the fixture contract until a reader-boundary change is intentionally made.

scope_limits: This review does not modify RTF files, library source, tests, coverage.json, manifest.json, or common metadata.
Raw RTF control presence, textutil output, native Word reopen, and hashes are file evidence; they are not semantic litchi-rtf parse success.
Hypotheses and candidate Word UI recipes are clearly separated from observed facts and require exact control checks after a future native save/reopen.

No claims are made about Word for Windows, older Word versions, Outlook transport production, SmartTag-capable legacy producers, rendering, pagination, recalculation, protection authentication, move execution, or external refresh.
